script_text: ARIES — Mars squares Saturn this week, forcing a serious career crossroads that demands bold, strategic action from you today. Wednesday shifts everything when Venus enters your 5th House, unlocking a passionate love doorway and reigniting creative fire within you. Mercury enters your 7th House Thursday, deepening emotional honesty in every partner conversation you have. Jupiter supports your 11th House through the weekend, expanding your community connections and long-term vision. Wednesday is your power day because Venus enters your 5th House, activating romance and creative expression in your life. Tuesday carries risk as Saturn's square to Mars could trigger impulsive career decisions that backfire by Friday. Let strategy replace speed; patience and fire are your greatest weapons against Saturn's pressure. Follow for daily updates.
